AECOM letter Ref MV Culvert Constructability Report Attn: Rory Poole Contract Ref: Reference 2.8.4 Design Review 2.8.5 Design Control and Co-ordination Dear Rory The Client makes reference to the consistent and poor support in relation to the MV Culvert Constructability report requested since 7th January 2025 which to date has still not been received. The client references your Service Level Agreement noting a number of key elements where the PMC have failed to provide the level of Service support required under your Contract Section 2.8.4 PMC shall review Consultants’ design documents as they are being developed to ensure that they are in accordance with Employer’s requirements, prepared in accordance with best revision control practice with sequential revision numbers/designations and revision tables; reflect site conditions, and are suitable for their intended purpose, advise and make recommendations with respect to such factors as fit for purpose, Value Engineering and constructability, suitability for local conditions; availability of materials and labour, time requirements for procurement and construction, compliance with HSE requirements, compliance with sustainability programs; and potential impact on project costs and time Section 2.8.4 (d) PMC shall ensure that Consultants assist, cooperate, meet and review with Employer, PMC, Cost Consultant (while still engaged on the Project), Contractors and other parties to participate in any cost estimates, value engineering studies or constructability studies, so as to aid in construction direction, analysis and overall economies in the Works. Section 2.8.5 (e) – Constructability PMC shall provide advice on methods of construction, time to construct, cost of construction, sequence of operations and the like in order that designs are configured to enable efficient construction and the avoidance of in-built construction problems. PMC shall subsequently provide feedback on constructability of the designs during the construction phase. The client expresses the further concern where the PMC has effectively outsourced and expedited this task as directed by the client to the CSC to undertake. There is a clear mis-understanding within your own staff of their responsibilities when this has been allowed to happen. A clear reference of your responsibility matrix within your contract expresses this key requirement as item 17 highlighted below. The Client fully expects this review to be conducted without further delay given the passage of time since the original request as wholly unacceptable. We fully expect you to align your team with their Service Responsibilities without delay and avoid mis-directing tasks within the Project Team. The Client reserves the right to claim for any losses either direct or indirect associated with the delay in respect of completing this review and assessment and the PMC shall consider this letter as notification of such. We expect the PMC to study the respective structure and revert with a complete Constructability and Cost analysis no later than 25th March 2025.
